name: @561-group/memetic-processing-unit
description: The Memetic Processing Unit: a processing unit whose word is a bilattice charge — a predication-bit, not a boolean bit — and whose instruction set is the structure-preserving four-regime descent and its modal calculus. Utterances (token, claim) are processed through articulate → predicate → posit → settle into a glued sheaf SECTION; nothing is reduced to a scalar. Data types sourced from @561-group/meme; the four-valued evidence, graph, exact-arithmetic, fixed-point and spectral mathematics are @lenticule-science/metrologic's, imported from it directly.
